name: mirage
text: Got the screenshot, thanks. In 4 minutes it shows 'nobody was selling' on Over 60.5 twice, Over 61.5, Kyshawn George Under 21.5 and Miami Heat Under 115.5, between two bets that did fill (Georgia State total $0.56, Louisiana Tech spread $2.43). The same two totals being tried again and again is the sign that they are re-listed right after each miss, as you said. The notices don't say whether the tries were automatic or by hand, or what price each one used. The NOFILL log line in your next saved report does. I'll match each of these to it and fix the re-listing path, then ship it. Please don't change settings on these in the meantime. I need the unchanged behaviour in the log.
